news.headline: Colts' Daniel Jones cleared for 7-on-7 work, 'looked good'
news.description: Colts quarterback Daniel Jones was cleared to participate in seven-on-seven drills Monday, marking yet another significant step in his comeback from a torn right Achilles tendon.

news.headline: Cardinals' Harrison still not recovered from '25 injuries
news.description: Cardinals wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. is still recovering from a rash of injuries that shortened his 2025 season but the third-year receiver doesn't think they'll linger into this coming season.

news.headline: After DJ Moore's exit, Rome Odunze 'ready' to be Bears' WR1
news.description: Chicago's Rome Odunze is looking for a more productive Year 3 with added responsibility after the team traded DJ Moore to the Bills.

news.headline: Josh Jacobs at Packers practice as prosecutors mull charges
news.description: Josh Jacobs is practicing with the Packers while prosecutors consider whether to file charges against the RB following his arrest on domestic abuse allegations.

news.headline: Falcons, Drake London reach 4-year, $141M extension, agent says
news.description: The Falcons and star wide receiver Drake London have agreed to terms on a four-year, $141 million contract extension, his agent, Andrew Kessler, told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

news.headline: Fantasy football: Which Bears pass catcher is the best value, riskiest and safest in drafts?

news.headline: Buccaneers' Godwin 'didn't believe' news of Evans' exit at first
news.description: Buccaneers wide receiver Chris Godwin Jr. said Tuesday that he learned Mike Evans was signing with the 49ers on social media, and it wasn't until quarterback Baker Mayfield texted him a "sad face" emoji that he believed the news was real.

news.headline: Chargers QB Herbert fixing footwork, aims for quicker release
news.description: In an effort to speed up his release, Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert is working with new offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel on overhauling his footwork this offseason.

news.headline: New Lions OC Drew Petzing leaving strong first impression

news.headline: Reaction mixed at Eagles' OTAs following A.J. Brown's departure
